name: Tarnasjo-Syter
description: Tarnasjo to Syter. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Tärnasjö hut / Tärnasjön lake water: Tärnasjö hut users fetch water from lake/nearby natural water. Not treated tap water.

Tärnasjön shoreline and archipelago water: The route follows Tärnasjön and crosses the archipelago. Water is abundant but the lake/wetland/bird-sensitive setting means avoid unnecessary shore/island disturbance and use judgment.
Syter hut / Svärfarbäcken water: Syter hut users fetch water from stream/lake; hut lies by/near Svärfarbäcken. Not treated tap water.
notes: Endpoint snapping policy at Tärnasjö and Syter: route-line endpoints, hut centroids, or explicit short access connectors.
Re-verify Tärnasjö outdoor toilet coordinate/source if standalone toilet import is required.
Refresh live currentness immediately before import: bridge closures/status, fire bans, SMHI warnings, STF hut seasons and transit timetables.
If importing bridge POIs, compute route proximity against the final chosen route line rather than the simplified route estimates in the facility lane.
